company.name: Ejari
company.shortDescription: Ejari provides a rent now, pay later service for residential properties.
company.description: Ejari is a real estate technology company that facilitates renting residential units with a pay later option. The platform allows customers to split their rental payments into monthly installments while securing the property upfront. It streamlines the rental process, handling necessary paperwork and providing support for both tenants and landlords.

productsAndServices.description: A financial service allowing tenants to pay rent monthly instead of annually or bi-annually, while landlords receive full payment upfront.
productsAndServices.name: Rent Now, Pay Later Service
